adjudication.summary: All 13 challenge-debt findings CONFIRMED in some form (none refuted; F-2/F-6/F-7 confirmed with corrected framing). The cut's clean spine is real and adversarially re-proven: blanket kill, §3 rung canon spec-exact, white-leg collapse core, §7 ambient strike, the veil rename, 60-gate budget held, zero orphaned readers, zero law violations, vue-tsc/vitest green. But both headline mechanisms fail structurally on the bytes: (1) the dock's earned darken (the G2 owner-edict "darken DYNAMICALLY like iOS 27") is dead end-to-end — the deleted tint clamp was the only element-level luma reader on the dock-plate chain, the claimed successor (veil clamp in @utility glass-plate) is unreachable from .dock-plate's :root-baked token chain, and two permanently-zero gradient layers remain painted — while the landed prose asserts the opposite; (2) the §5 grasp register is triply non-functional: zero reachable consumers (both spec-named "⊘ live" consumers put data-held on non-rung roots), wrong held/release endpoints that fail §5.4's own armed band falsifier analytically (held 0.084 vs floor 0.132 at f=1, plus a one-frame .14→.22 release pop), and a cascade tie lost to .glass-card by import order so only will-change survives on the named "consumer plate". The R-1 dead-mechanism shape the wave was cut to kill is re-introduced in two places (zero-alpha tint veils, identity crown lerp). Four rulings in IMPLEMENT-ADJUDICATION.json are factually false at HEAD (§4 dock-darken, §5 host-suppression, §6 one-white-declaration — two live white insets at α .26/.22 breach A-5, §8.3 fence-untouched — segmented.css touched + 64/109-line dock/drawer churn). None of this is curable by π; it requires a cure-cut (re-land element-level dock darken, rewire grasp topology + endpoints + import order, A-5 leg fixes, prose/record corrections, F-B4 bracket ruling) followed by adjudication-record correction, after which the candidate may re-claim and the driver's π battery decides the seal. LANDED-CANDIDATE is therefore DEMOTED, not cured in place.

findings.finding: F-1 (A, CRITICAL): dock's earned darken dead; landed prose asserts the opposite; two zero-alpha gradient layers remain
findings.ruling: CONFIRMED. Verified: deleted --glass-tint-strength clamp was the sole element-level luma reader on the dock-plate chain; .dock-plate paints --glass-plate-dock, a :root-baked token composed from --glass-veil-dock (base − step, no luma term), which cannot see the el-scoped --glass-backdrop-luma write (useGlassBackdropLuminance.ts:248); the only dock chain reaching @utility glass-plate is search.css:44 (the field, not the plate); the observer's derived --glass-backdrop bucket is a documented self-match no-op; --dock-plate-tint-veil (dock.css:114) and --sheet-tint-veil (drawer/styles.css:188) each have one writer, alpha 0, still painted — the exact R-1 dead-mechanism shape. The @container light bucket is now value-identical to the unconditional rule (no-op). CURE: re-land the darken at the element — compose the dock plate through the veil clamp at the element level (tier=dock) or reinstate an element-level luma-clamped tint strength driving the veil layers; strike or re-liven both zero-alpha gradient layers; correct adaptive-legibility.css:36-41 and search.css prose; delete or re-differentiate the no-op container bucket.

findings.finding: F-2 (A, HIGH): --glass-veil-sheet ≡ --glass-veil-overlay; drawer crown descent lerp is a dead identity
findings.ruling: CONFIRMED, framing corrected. Sheet at +2 is spec-conformant (APOTHEOSIS-SPEC:133 pins sheet +2 = .22, same as overlay), so the token equality is not the divergence — the defect is that the cut translated the pre-cut live opacity lerp (crown thinned .95→.74 across descent, verified at 4b1a9733^) onto an ink axis with coincident endpoints: (overlay − sheet)·descent ≡ 0, crown constant .22, while drawer/styles.css:164-171 and tokens/glass.css:137-139 assert a live lerp. Identity arithmetic wearing a mechanism's name — the R-1 shape. CURE: either give the crown a distinct descent endpoint (a crown-target rung below +2, amended into the deep-tier table) or declare the crown constant and strike the dead lerp + both prose sites; one or the other, ruled not drifted.

findings.finding: F-3 (A, HIGH): two live white insets above A-5's 0.12 ceiling; 'exactly ONE white ink declaration' is false; ContinuousMarkers stacks a second rim leg
findings.ruling: CONFIRMED. Verified live at HEAD: GlassTimeline.vue:225 white α .26; ContinuousMarkers.vue:273-275 white α .22 stacked beside var(--glass-material-rim) on the same box (two rim legs, forbidden by A-5's same clause). Both pre-existed the cut, but the cut edited GlassTimeline.vue without curing its leg, and the adjudication's one-white-declaration census claim is false as stated. The census arm (glass-subtlety.test.ts:359+) reads only glass-fx.css/dark-arm.css --glass-* declarations in hsl/rgb spellings and cannot see .vue 'white' spellings — upgrading the booked spelling-narrowness residue from hypothetical gap to proven breach. CURE: bring both legs to ≤0.12 or re-express through the rim tokens; collapse ContinuousMarkers' double rim to one leg; widen the existing A-5 arm (no new gate) to sweep src/**/*.{css,vue} across all white spellings.

findings.finding: F-4 (A, HIGH): grasp register has zero reachable consumers; §5.1's E-3 naming duty not discharged; naive binding silently flattens the plate
findings.ruling: CONFIRMED. Verified: grasp.css:32 requires [data-held] ON the rung-class element; Slider.vue:197/203 and GlassDock.vue:313/328 put data-held on roots (.glass-slider/.glass-dock) carrying none of the seven classes, while the glass surfaces (.slider-range, .dock-plate) are descendants with neither attribute nor class — the spec's '⊘ live' consumer citations (SPEC:239-241) are structurally unmatchable. Carriers (glass-grasp-carrier/data-grasp/data-releasing) exist nowhere outside grasp.css and the gate's own regexes. grasp.css:34's backdrop-filter:none with no mounted carrier is a silent-flatten hazard for the first naive binding. CURE: reshape the engage selector to the real consumer topology or move rung class + attribute onto the plate elements; mount the carriers in both named consumers in the binding cut; extend the existing grasp arm to assert engage-selector/carrier co-occurrence.

findings.finding: F-5 (A, MEDIUM-HIGH): grasp held/release endpoints ignore the luma clamp; §5.4 clause-1 band falsifier fails analytically; +57% one-frame release pop
findings.ruling: CONFIRMED. Verified the three declarations: rest resolves the clamped rung (veil.css:39), held = 0.6·raw-tier (grasp.css:37), release = raw tier (grasp.css:107). A-11/§5.4's band [0.6·α_r, α_r] is explicitly 'at any sampled f', so α_r is the clamped rest ink: at f=1 resting, held .084 < floor .132 — fails by construction, and π-2 would misdiagnose it as a mount defect. On [data-releasing] drop the ink steps .14→.22 in one frame (rest rules transition only box-shadow/border-color). CURE: factor the clamped rest rung into one token (computed in the glass-plate utility); held = 0.6× that token, releasing = that token — band holds by construction, attribute drop becomes value-identical, pop dies.

findings.finding: F-6 (A, MEDIUM): collision-fence breaches; §8.3 'all untouched' ruling factually wrong
findings.ruling: CONFIRMED IN PART. Facts verified: segmented.css touched (4 prose-only lines); dock/drawer took 64+/109− across 12 files vs the fence's 'beyond §7's two lines'; the prior adjudication's HONORED/all-untouched ruling is factually false and must be corrected. But the remedy is narrower than 'the fold waits for #7': §7.5's own parenthetical pre-authorizes §4's re-key of the adaptive-legibility tint lines 'in the same cut', and §6's token deletions force mechanical re-points wherever --glass-highlight/--glass-specular/--glass-bg-* were read (a dangling var() would breach no-orphan-reads). Genuinely discretionary inside the fence: the dead-darken replacement (cured under F-1), the lone --glass-rim-top leg at tab-button.css:138 (half the paired rim canon), search.css's @apply glass-plate conversion. CURE: adjudication record corrected to fence-BENT with mandated-vs-discretionary enumeration; discretionary deltas routed to #7's consolidated round; tab-button's lit leg paired as --glass-material-rim or deferred to #7.

findings.finding: F-7 (A, MEDIUM): six off-diagonal ink/radius pairings; 'a rung is a thickness of the same glass' unenforced at surfaces
findings.ruling: CONFIRMED, one site re-classed. Verified live: SegmentedTimeline.vue:190-192 (floating ink/quiet radius), GlassTimeline.vue:184-188 (resting ink/floating radius), button/styles.css:48-50 (quiet ink/resting radius) — all against §3.5's one-radius-per-ink table, two re-pointed by this very commit without reconciling; §9 disposes none of them. instrument-chassis (chassis ink/quiet radius) is UNPINNED rather than off-diagonal — the spec never assigns deep-tier radii. A-3/A-4 census the axes independently, so the monotone-dilution property is provable of the table and false of the surfaces. CURE: reconcile each calm-rung surface to one rung, or record a deliberate per-site off-diagonal exemption in §13 (small-element blur-mush is a defensible ground, but it must be ruled); pair the axes in the existing A-3/A-4 census, no new gate.

findings.finding: F-B1 (B, HIGH): grasp register is a complete no-op on .glass-card via cascade tie + source order; only will-change survives
findings.ruling: CONFIRMED. Verified: glass.css imports grasp.css before surfaces.css; .glass-card (surfaces.css:15) declares @apply glass-plate (inlining the clamped --glass-veil-rung), backdrop-filter: var(--glass-blur-resting), and a box-shadow/border-color transition — all three collide with grasp's engage/release declarations at tied (0,1,0) specificity and win by source order, in source and in the built bundle. On .glass-card[data-held] only will-change: backdrop-filter survives, inverting the file's 'rest cost is exactly zero' and 'host is the one never-filtering layer' claims for the rung it names the consumer plate; B's stacked-blur arithmetic (1.326× mid-release vs the 'unconstructible' 1.25 bound) follows. Latent today (F-4: no in-repo binding) but breaks at #27/#47, and demo/stories/dock/overview.vue already documents data-held. CURE: move the grasp.css @import after surfaces.css (still after rim.css, before a11y-fallback.css; amend §8.1's import-order invariant line), and add a cascade-order assertion to the existing grasp arm.

findings.finding: F-B2 (B, MEDIUM): the grasp gate seat cannot observe the register it certifies; the 1.25-bound arm is a tautology over local literals
findings.ruling: CONFIRMED. Verified: all six arms (glass-subtlety.test.ts:450-511) are single-file regex reads of grasp.css — none can see cascade order, import order, or consumers, which is exactly how the §5 ruling greened while false for .glass-card. The bound assertion computes √(1+φ²)/φ ≤ 1.25 from a local const φ=1.625 — true in any repository state (the arm's contains-checks are not tautological; the bound line is). CURE: extend the existing describe with a source-order assertion over src/styles/glass.css (grasp after every rung-class-declaring partial), and derive φ from the file's parsed literal or strike the decorative bound line. No gate minted.

findings.finding: F-B3 (B, MEDIUM): the blanket's declared successor discipline (nested-plate depth ≤ 2) is a non-detector for its own property
findings.ruling: CONFIRMED, with precision. Verified: material.css:57 names a DOM-composition invariant; the arm (glass-subtlety.test.ts:425-447) measures CSS selector-text depth (observed max 1 vs bound 2 — a full level of slack, cannot fail realistically); the property's only real habitat is Vue templates — CommandDialog renders Command (root 'command glass-floating', Command.vue:31) inside DialogContent (resolver emits glass-floating, default surface glass): two nested filtering plates shipped today, invisible to the scan. Precision: the shipped case sits AT the ≤2 bound, not over it — the defect is detector honesty, not a breach. CURE: re-point the existing arm to a template class-nesting walk over src/**/*.vue, or move the assertion into the π battery as a runtime ancestor-filter count; re-word material.css:57 to cite where the assertion genuinely lives.

findings.finding: F-B4 (B, LOW-MEDIUM): prefers-reduced-transparency bracket silently lost its white-inset kill; the rim now survives on the flattened plate
findings.ruling: CONFIRMED at LOW. Verified in the diff: --glass-highlight: 0 0 0 0 transparent deleted from both brackets; at HEAD the reduce bracket sets only --glass-level/--glass-grain-opacity, and the rim tokens carry no level term, so ex-highlight surfaces keep a 0.08-0.10 white hairline the pre-cut bracket explicitly zeroed. forced-colors is safe (box-shadow forced off), and the hairline is arguably opaque decoration rather than transparency — but the delta is real and unremarked. CURE: one line neutralizing --glass-material-rim in the reduce bracket (house 0-alpha idiom), or a recorded one-word §13 ruling that the hairline survives deliberately. Ruled, not drifted.

findings.finding: F-B5 (B, LOW): two stale-prose sites the wave itself minted (search.css morph.css claim; property-regs.css clamp citation)
findings.ruling: CONFIRMED. Verified: morph.css declares neither --glass-veil-ink nor --glass-veil-rung at HEAD (search.css:36-38's 're-points them' claim is false, and it compounds F-1 by asserting a dead lockstep); property-regs.css:234 cites glass/ladder.css + dock/morph.css for a clamp that lives only in glass/veil.css:39-50 (ladder.css has zero veil-rung hits). Distinct from the booked ladder.css/surface-axis.css residue. CURE: correct both citations to glass/veil.css in the same prose pass as F-1's corrections.

findings.finding: F-B6 (B, flagged PLAUSIBLE): host will-change: backdrop-filter may form a Backdrop Root, making carriers sample the host's own veil instead of the page
findings.ruling: CONFIRMED as a legitimately-routed π item with a defensive cure now. No browser seat is available to this adjudication, so ruled on spec grounds: Filter Effects 2's backdrop-root formation includes will-change naming a grouping property, so the hazard is real-in-spec and engine behavior is the open question. The cure is cheap and independent of the answer: strike will-change: backdrop-filter from the engage rule — it names a property that never changes on the host (per F-B1 it is also the only declaration surviving on .glass-card), the animated property is carrier opacity (carrier-side will-change: opacity if needed) — eliminating the hazard class entirely; π-2 confirms paint over a patterned backdrop.
